biotools.summary: KIASORT is a geometry-free spike sorting algorithm that tracks neuron-specific drift in high-density neural recordings, offering a complete and user-friendly platform with automated sorting and manual curation capabilities. It is freely available and designed to outperform existing methods while maintaining real-time performance.
